Founding Commercial Partner
Quantum Highlands
Remote

# Founding Commercial Partner We are looking for a commercially ambitious operator who wants to build the outward-facing side of an advanced technology organisation. The opportunity is unique, and includes scientists and engineers with senior backgrounds from Cern, ESA Exomars, MIT, Formula One and NATO R&D (amongst others). The technical platform is being developed by a specialist engineering team working across quantum, electromagnetic and precision hardware systems. What is now needed is someone equally capable on the commercial side: strategy, capital, partnerships, communications, positioning, institutional relationships and eventually a team built around that function. This is not a consultancy role and not a conventional 9-to-5 job. It is an opportunity to become a key part of the organisation, take real ownership and participate meaningfully in the value created. ## The role Initially, the work is practical: * sharpen materials and positioning * identify investors, partners and institutions * open conversations and secure meetings * manage relationships and follow-up * coordinate legal, financial and commercial matters * develop strategic partnerships * help build the commercial structure around the technology The engagement can initially be flexible and remote, with international work across European and US time zones. Momentum is key, 9-5 is not. ## The person The right person is entrepreneurial, commercially sharp and comfortable operating without a large corporate structure around them. Strong communication, judgement, initiative and persistence matter more than a particular CV. Experience across venture building, finance, business development, partnerships, family office, investment, corporate development or professional services would be useful. Excellent spoken and written English (ideally mother tongue) is important. French, German, Italian or Spanish - would be an advantage. Madarin, Japanese or Korean also useful. Knowledge of basic legal, accounting and corporate procedure is essential. Technical expertise is not required. Our time will be spent properly explaining the physics, engineering and applications so that the commercial side becomes fluent in the technology without needing to become the mad scientist in the laboratory. That remains our job:) ## Why this model The mythology of the all-purpose technology CEO belongs largely to a bygone era (of the early 2000s) when the underlying platforms were already mature. Software, smartphones, cars and even modern rockets are built on established engineering disciplines, supply chains and industrial systems. Frontier hardware is different. The organisation needs to operate more like an orchestra than a rock band with one superstar frontman. The engineers should remain deeply focused on physics and implementation. The commercial function should be equally focused on capital, partnerships, representation and building the institution around them. Elite athletes already work this way. Their managers, agents and commercial teams handle the business so the athlete can concentrate on performance. The same principle applies here. The objective is not to turn engineers into salespeople or commercial people into physicists. It is to build two strong functions that understand each other and work together in concert. For the right person, this is effectively an opportunity to build the commercial business around a serious technical platform - that has meaningful impact on addressing our sustainability and energy bottlenecks - assemble the commerical team and grow into a central leadership position with meaningful equity - as the engineering itself matures. The technology is being built. The business around it is still wide open.

### 🌟 About You Are you a systems builder who gets excited about owning the entire technical foundation of an AI company from day one? Do you want to architect infrastructure that legal insurers trust with their most sensitive data and highest-volume workflows? Are you the kind of engineer who ships production systems, sets the bar for the team, and cares as much about customers as about code? If so, we should talk. ### 🚀 About INC iudexnc AG (Iudex Non Calculat) is a pre-seed AI startup based in Zurich, building cognitive infrastructure that automates coverage checks and case handling for legal insurance companies. Legal insurance is a €16.8B European market serving 150M+ policyholders — and every single case still requires 15–45 minutes of manual review by a human claims handler. We compress that to under 2 minutes. We already have a paid pilot with a Swiss legal insurer, a working prototype in production testing, active conversations with several major DACH insurers, and two co-founders: a technical CEO (MSc Applied Math, ETH Zurich; previously built an AI legal tech product with 120+ B2B customers) and a commercial co-founder with deep DACH insurance and enterprise BD experience. What we need now is a third co-founder who owns engineering and infrastructure end-to-end. Our long-term vision: make legal insurance affordable for everyone in the world. Our near-term path there: become the trusted cognitive infrastructure layer for European legal insurers. ### 🛠️ Your Role You will own everything technical. This is not a senior engineer hire — it is a co-founder role with equal equity, full ownership of engineering and infrastructure, and a seat at every strategic decision. - **Architecture & Infrastructure:** Design and own the system architecture as we scale from single-customer prototype to multi-insurer production platform. Multicloud deployments, per-insurer data isolation, and infrastructure-grade reliability are on your roadmap. - **AI Systems:** Co-own (with Ari) the LLM agent systems that power coverage analysis — fact extraction, policy cross-referencing, exclusion checking, decision drafting. Push accuracy, latency, and cost in the right directions. - **Security & Compliance:** Own data sovereignty, pseudonymization, audit trails, and compliance architecture (Swiss DSG, DSGVO, EU AI Act). "Trusted infrastructure" is ultimately a technical claim — you make it true. - **Engineering Culture:** Set the bar on code quality, testing, observability, and engineering practices. Build the technical hiring pipeline alongside Ari. Every engineer we hire should raise the bar. - **Technical Hiring:** Co-own recruiting for the engineering team as we grow from 3 to 10+ people. - **Product & Customers:** Talk to insurers regularly. Understand their technical environments, integration requirements, and data constraints firsthand. Great infrastructure is built by people who understand the customer. - **Company Building:** Help shape strategy, culture, and operations as an equal co-founder. We make decisions through written docs, not meetings. We value ownership, speed, and honest disagreement. ### 📌 What We're Looking For ### ✅ Must-haves - Strong systems engineering and applied AI background. You've built and shipped production systems that handle real data at meaningful scale. - Track record of technical leadership at the right level — ex-staff/principal engineer at a top company, or ex-CTO/founding engineer of a B2B AI or infrastructure startup. - Product taste. You build things that work for users, not just things that are technically interesting. - High agency: you identify what matters and go do it without waiting for instructions. - Comfort with ambiguity and early-stage chaos. You've either built something before or operated in an environment where nothing was figured out yet. - Based in or willing to relocate to Zurich / Western Europe. On-site collaboration matters at this stage. - Fluent in English. German is a strong plus. ### 🎯 Strong signals - Experience with regulated industries (insurance, finance, health, government) where data sovereignty, compliance, and auditability are non-negotiable. - Depth in LLM systems, retrieval, evaluation pipelines, or agentic workflows in production. - Experience with multicloud or multi-tenant infrastructure for enterprise customers. - Missionary mindset: you want to build something enduring, not optimize for the next exit. - Previous founder experience or very early employee at a startup. ### 🤝 What We Offer - **Equal equity split (~33/33/33)**, vested over 4 years with a 1-year cliff. You are a co-founder, not an employee. - **Two co-founders already in place.** Ari (technical CEO, ETH Math/ML, built previous AI legal tech to 120+ customers) and Simon (Commercial, deep DACH insurance BD, ex-UNIQA/Baloise/Swisscom). You won't be guessing whether there's a product or a market — both already exist. - **A massive, concentrated market** with clear buyers. ~25 large legal insurers control 80%+ of premiums in DACH alone. The technical surface area is growing fast: multicloud, sensitive data, insurer-specific logic, compliance constraints. - **Autonomy and ownership.** We operate with high trust, direct feedback, and written decision-making. No politics, no micromanagement. - **A mission that scales.** We start by building infrastructure insurers trust. We end by making legal protection accessible to billions of people worldwide. ### 🔍 Our Process We take this search extremely seriously and it’s optional for us to fill it. Expect a multi-round process including deep technical and values conversations with all founders, a working trial on a real INC problem, and reference checks. We'd rather keep the seat open for a year than fill it with the wrong person. Tell us about a system you built that you're proud of, and why building trusted AI infrastructure for insurers excites you.
